note: Prompt sets for prompt test PT02, written before any answer was compared with a label. Changing this file makes a new test.

fixed.scan_read_once: the scan and everything before the question are processed once per scan and reused; the question is then fed one token at a time, as generation does. Checked against the ordinary call on the first scan and every 20th: same text required, otherwise the run stops.

A.idea: baseline: the wording used so far
A.template: Is {phrase} present in this CT? Answer only Yes or No.

A2.idea: harmless rewording 1 (for the wording-stability check and the vote)
A2.template: Does this CT show {phrase}? Answer only Yes or No.

A3.idea: harmless rewording 2 (for the wording-stability check and the vote)
A3.template: Is there {phrase} in this CT scan? Answer only Yes or No.

B.idea: reasoning on: the baseline wording, the model may think before it answers
B.template: Is {phrase} present in this CT? Answer only Yes or No.

C.idea: a plain definition inside the question
C.template: Is {phrase} ({definition}) present in this CT? Answer only Yes or No.

D.idea: report first: the model writes its structured report, then is asked with that report in the conversation
D.report_prompt: write a structured chest CT report
D.template: Based on the CT and your report, is {phrase} present? Answer only Yes or No.

E.idea: location first: asked where, with None as an offered answer
E.template: Where in this CT is {phrase}? Answer with the location, or answer None if it is not present.

V.idea: vote of the three wordings A, A2, A3: present when at least two say present
V.rule: majority; a scan-condition with an unreadable answer in any of the three is unreadable

reading.yes_no: after any reasoning block: first word 'yes' -> present, 'no' -> absent, anything else -> unreadable (counted, never guessed)
reading.location: after any reasoning block: first word none / no / nowhere / absent / not -> absent; empty -> unreadable; anything else -> present

analysis.main_measure: macro balanced accuracy = mean over conditions with >= 10 positive scans of (found share + correctly-absent share) / 2, scan level
analysis.counts: found / missed / extra / correctly absent per condition and set, always reported
analysis.secondary: AUROC of the Yes-score per condition for sets that have one
analysis.unreadable: an unreadable answer counts as wrong for that scan-condition (missed if labelled, extra if not)
analysis.rule: a set replaces A only if (1) the interval of its macro-balanced-accuracy difference to A is entirely above 0, (2) no condition with >= 10 positive scans is more than 0.05 below A in balanced accuracy, (3) its unreadable share is at most 0.01; among several, the highest macro balanced accuracy
analysis.stability: wording stability = share of scan-conditions where A, A2 and A3 give the same answer; error rate of A is reported separately for unanimous and for split scan-conditions

conditions.definition: hazy increased lung density that does not hide the vessels
dense lung opacity that hides the vessels
a small rounded lung opacity up to 3 cm
areas of abnormally low lung density from destroyed air spaces
thickened lines between the lung lobules
a patchwork of lung regions with different density
scar-like fibrotic bands or changes in the lung
calcium in the wall of the aorta or other arteries
calcium in the walls of the coronary arteries
part of the stomach above the diaphragm
devices such as catheters, pacemakers, stents, surgical clips or sutures
